_note: Hand coding by the columbaria lane worker, 11 October 2026 UTC, after the plan freeze (afdd69f). One object per columbarium row. Fields left out take the defaults in scripts/assemble.py. key = ASI site id (src ASI), WBADB row id (src WBADB) or a literature key (src LIT, REPO). dup_of = the representative row of the same columbarium (dup rows are kept for provenance and not counted). Codes: lev2/lev3/acc/date/natof as PLAN.md §2, §6. quote = 12 words or fewer, only where it is the evidence for a non-UNKNOWN distinctive code. basis notes: EVIDENCE unless marked INFERENCE or CLAIM. cons 'rock-cut' was set for ASI rows whose record sentences on the columbarium say it is hewn or cut (a scripted check, then reviewed; eight false positives reverted).
